title_en: Get an Exclusive Preview of The Infernal Hulk vs. The Avengers Before Marvel's Epic Hulk War: Infernal Rage Crossover Begins
summary_en: Check out our exclusive preview of The Infernal Hulk vs. The Avengers #1, the last stage of Marvel's buildup to 2027's epic Hulk War: Infernal Rage crossover.
body_en:
Marvel Comics is positioning Hulk War: Infernal Rage as one of its key crossover storylines for 2027. The climax of writer Phillip Kennedy Johnson's Hulk saga so far, Hulk War: Infernal Rage explores what happens when Hulk (now possessed by a demonic entity known as The Eldest) amasses an army of corrupted heroes and declares war on the Marvel Universe. And while that story doesn't officially kick off until February, Marvel is set to publish a crucial lead-in story this December.
IGN can exclusively debut a new preview of The Infernal Hulk vs. The Avengers #1, the last of Marvel's Hulk war prelude specials. Check it out in the slideshow gallery below:
The Infernal Hulk vs. The Avengers #1 is written by Johnson, with art by Carlos Magno and a cover by Nic Klein. Here's Marvel's official summary of the issue:
Look for The Infernal Hulk vs. The Avengers #1 to hit stores on December 2, followed by Hulk War: Infernal Rage #1 in February. You can preorder these comics at your local comic shop.
For more, see our breakdown of the ending to Avengers: Armageddon and check out a revealing new preview of Star Wars/Marvel: Hope Assembles #1 .
